title: Male seahorses give birth to up to 2,000 babies at once
subject: seahorse

scenes.text: In seahorses, the dads give birth. And not to just one baby.
The female places her eggs in a pouch on the male's belly, where they are fertilized.
For 10 to 25 days, depending on the species, he carries them.
Then muscle contractions push out as many as 2,000 tiny seahorses.
They get no care after birth, and fewer than 5 in every 1,000 reach adulthood.
A father of 2,000 might see fewer than ten of them grow up.

description:
In seahorses, the dads give birth, and not to just one baby.
A male can release up to 2,000 young at once.
Could you handle that pregnancy?
first_comment: Which animal dad deserves the biggest respect?
